messages.label: Sent
messages.subject: Jake Essex for Cabbage Patch?
messages.body:
Hi,

I'm Natalie. I look after bookings for Jake Essex.

Jake would be a great fit for the Cabbage Patch in Twickenham, and he'd
love to come and perform for you.

He's performed in over 500 venues over the past 10 years and built a good
reputation for singing the classics without the corny impersonation. He's
branching out to new venues now.

Jake is a professional solo vocalist from Essex. 50s, 60s and into the 70s:
Darin, Dion, Holly, Orbison, Sinatra, Elvis & more. He is the act. No
tribute, no jumpsuit, no corny impersonations. Own PA, fully
self-contained, no deposit.

Have a look: www.jakeessex.co.uk

Saturday nights this year and into 2027. If a date works, just reply here
and I'll lock it in.

Natalie
